sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 5.2 grams of fat. Saturated fat is 0.6 grams, supporting a cleaner fat profile. Omega 3 is 280 milligrams, supporting a more useful fat profile, but it is the softer support mark in this section. For a legume, fibre and practicality are supposed to carry the case.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 8.9 grams of carbs. Glycemic index is 18 GI, helping with steadier carb behaviour. Starch is 1 gram, weak for useful staple-carb payoff, which is a meaningful miss for legumes. For legumes, the carbs look much better when fibre and protein are both backing them up.
